capabilities: Render the vault as an interactive galaxy of folders and notes
Drill down through tree and folder views to open notes
Search the vault and browse recently updated notes
Show activity heatmaps and note-growth trajectories
Detect orphan notes, unresolved links, and stale notes
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a navigation and review dashboard, not a knowledge-graph data tool or a spaced-repetition flashcard app.
extras: Runs fully locally with no external APIs; installs via GitHub Releases zip as well as the community plugin directory; the manifest warns it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph and file views make a large vault hard to navigate and offer no activity history or stale/orphan-note overview.
summary: Vault visualization plugin that renders Markdown notes as an animated galaxy map, a hierarchical tree, activity heatmaps, and knowledge-health panels.
